name: @effectified/emoji-picker-element
tagline: a web component bound from its manifest

decisions.question: Which exported functions and classes does the facade offer?
decisions.why: the exports the package README calls

decisions.question: Which method releases a default, so acquiring one opens a scope? ("none" keeps it unscoped)
decisions.why: its type has no release method

decisions.question: Which events of default does the facade offer as Streams? ("none" for none)
Which upstream failures become which tagged errors?
decisions.why: exported error classes, most specific first, then the catch-all EmojiPickerElementError carrying `code` (the source sets no codes)

decisions.question: Which handles are provided as services (Context.Service with a layer)?
decisions.why: every offered export that acquires a releasable handle

decisions.question: Which release of its upstream's major.minor is the facade? (its npm version is `<major>.<minor>.<revision - 1>`)
decisions.why: engine 0.5.0: published on npm as 1.29.4 (`npm install @effectified/emoji-picker-element effect`), its version emoji-picker-element's major.minor and the facade's releases for it (4 before this one, GitHub releases `emoji-picker-element-v1.29.1` to `emoji-picker-element-v1.29.1+4`); its package.json names effectified/packages as its repository, which npm checks as the release workflow publishes, and its README, skill and docs.json install it from npm by name
